track.name: Yard Loop
track.description: Yellow gantry: keep the center asphalt for a safe exit, or cross the inside gravel to catch the turquoise boost pad. Straighten before boosting.

track.description: Set up early for the linked corners.

track.name: Dockside Dash
track.description: Twin dock lights: the gravel-side boost strip rewards a precise line. The center asphalt leaves room to pass and brake. Keep every checkpoint in order.

track.name: Furnace Bend
track.description: Furnace stacks: a tight inside gravel line leads to a boost strip; the outside asphalt gives more grip and recovery room. Save charge for the exit.

parts.name: Anvil
parts.description: Stable at speed. Slower to change direction.

parts.name: Capacitor
parts.description: A longer boost reserve, with additional weight.

parts.name: Courier
parts.description: Light and controllable. Reaches its speed limit earlier.

parts.name: Flywheel
parts.description: Lighter kit. Grip recovers more quickly after handbraking.

parts.name: Kite
parts.description: Light and quick to rotate. More sensitive to contact.

parts.name: Longrunner
parts.description: Strong on fast straights. Heavier through slow corners.

parts.name: Mule
parts.description: Predictable handling. A broad window to recover a slide.

parts.description: Better loose-surface control, less asphalt peak grip.
